Companion animal travel requirements notice

Travelers must confirm the crate and age limits before check-in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Reptile travel begins when a reptile reaches 11 weeks, meaning the animal is old enough to fly at the youngest permitted age. This limit supports safe handling, stable feeding routines, and careful boarding.

For your Blue cat, the crate must fit the allowed size; a cat has a longest crate side limit of 61 cm, meaning the greatest measurement of one crate edge cannot be greater than that length. Use a sturdy, escape-proof carrier with secure closure, clear access for inspection, and ventilation that remains unobstructed throughout the journey.

If you arrive without compliance, processing will take longer and travel may be refused for the companion animal. Please review paperwork and bring the correct carrier size and label details so the desk can verify quickly.

For tailored clearance steps, contact or visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk before your departure.
